jobs.title: Customer Value Partner, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description_text:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
The Opportunity
We’re expanding our Strategic Accounts post-sale team and are looking for a Customer Value Partner, Strategic Accounts to own a handful of our most complex, high-impact enterprise partnerships.
This is a senior individual contributor role and the post-sale counterpart to our Strategic Account Executives. Your focus is to ensure customers experience Multiverse as a seamless, proactive partner; turning commitments into outcomes, building long-term trust with senior stakeholders, and creating the conditions for sustainable account growth.
Once here, you will:
Own the end-to-end customer journey for key strategic accounts, from launch through long-term value realisation.
Build deep, multi-threaded relationships across customer stakeholders (HR, executive sponsors, business leaders, department partners, line managers) and understand internal dynamics to engage the right people at the right time.
Partner with executive sponsors to broaden engagement across senior leaders and the teams responsible for execution, ensuring learning outcomes translate into measurable business impact.
Create and run joint success plans and discovery workshops with customers (outcomes, milestones, governance, success metrics), and hold a clear operating rhythm to drive progress.
Lead Executive Business Reviews / Quarterly Business Reviews that demonstrate value realised, celebrate shared wins, and course-correct where needed.
Translate delivery outcomes into compelling proof: share learner projects and impact stories with relevant leaders (e.g., department directors) to spark new use cases and strategic business reviews.
Partner closely with a dedicated onboarding/implementation counterpart to ensure a smooth launch and strong first 90 days, then maintain strategic oversight as programmes run.
Collaborate with Sales and Business Value Consultants to strengthen the value narrative and ensure the customer has a clear, evidence-backed view of value over time.
Act as a trusted internal voice of the customer: align Delivery, Product and Support to remove barriers, raise quality, and improve the overall customer experience.
Re-engage the Strategic Account Executive once a commercial opportunity to expand or renew is identified. Note, as a Strategic CVP you do not ‘own’ the commercial expansion outcome.
What you bring:
5–8+ years of experience in strategic customer success, strategic account management, consulting, or professional services working with complex enterprise customers.
Executive presence and the ability to build trust and influence across senior stakeholder groups in large organisations.
A track record of building structured success plans, running executive governance, and tying work to measurable outcomes (not just activity).
Strong program leadership and operational discipline: you can operate strategically while keeping a high bar for execution, risk management, and follow-through.

jobs.title: Operational Controls Lead
jobs.location: London or remote within the UK
jobs.description_text:
About Griffin
Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.
We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.
We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.
Learn more about what we do
Our culture
We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.
We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work 
and
 home life.
We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.
Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.
Learn more about our culture.
The team
You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, working across all operations functions This team is the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale.
The opportunity
We're looking for someone to become the person who tells us, with confidence, whether our operations are actually working the way we think they are. You'll build and run our first-line controls programme from the ground up, working across deeply technical specialists and senior stakeholders alike. As Griffin scales, our control framework has to scale with it. You'll be central to making that happen, turning quality controls and assurance into a genuine source of confidence for the business.
What success looks like
In your first year, you'll have built meaningful relationships across every corner of Griffin, from operations teams to second line risk and compliance. You'll have helped stand up our controls capabilities from scratch, and you'll have taken full ownership of the RCSA process for the Service guild. Along the way, you'll have developed the QA/QC testing frameworks and MI that help leadership see exactly where our controls are strong and where they need attention.
To do this you'll own
Quality assurance reviews and quality control testing across operations, ensuring processes are executed accurately and in line with approved procedures
Sample-based testing and control checks, identifying errors, control gaps, exceptions, and potential operational risks
Corrective action and remediation plans, working with operations teams to close out issues within agreed timelines
The Service guild controls attestation framework, and support risk owners in first-line RCSA exercises
QA/QC testing frameworks, control checklists, sampling methodologies, and quality standards
Regular QA/QC reporting and MI, feeding into Griffin-wide operational risk reporting
Coordination of internal audit, external audit, compliance, risk, and regulatory reviews, providing evidence of operational controls and remediation

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how

jobs.title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
jobs.description_text:
Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx.
I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies.
Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work.
We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly.
It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business.
Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below.
About hyperexponential (hx)
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
About the People team
Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it.
Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure.
You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room..
What you'll be doing

jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
jobs.description_text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.
 
We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 
We are seeking an experienced Director of Enterprise Sales to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.
Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.
What you’ll do as a Director of Enterprise Sales at Vanta:
Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts
Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment
Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta
Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles
Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy
Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy
Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment
Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region
How to be successful in this role:
Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots
Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.
Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region
Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it
Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders
Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity
Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans
Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change
Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

jobs.title: Senior Leader - Product Marketing
jobs.description_text:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
About the role
Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.
We're hiring a Senior Leader of Product Marketing, reporting to the CPTO, to own the positioning, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market orchestration that makes that story credible to buyers who've heard "AI transformation" pitches before and have learned to discount them. This is a strategic leadership and launch-execution role: you're accountable for a narrative that has to survive a skeptical CTO's follow-up questions, not just land in a pitch deck.
You'll sit at the center of Product, Engineering, Sales, B2B Marketing, CS, and executive leadership — turning hard technical work into a case buyers trust, giving Sales what they need to win the deals that matter, and grounding pricing and roadmap decisions in real market evidence.
Growth today comes primarily through our sales motion — there isn't yet a significant inbound or demand-generation engine to lean on. This role needs to work effectively within that reality now, while helping shape what comes next, rather than assuming a demand-gen infrastructure that doesn't currently exist.
What you'll own
Positioning & narrative
Define and defend the category narrative and product positioning — including translating technical/AI capabilities into value claims that hold up under scrutiny from technical buyers, procurement, and security review, without overclaiming
Own messaging architecture across product lines and keep it consistent as the portfolio grows
Market & competitive intelligence
Run competitive intelligence (win-loss analysis, competitor tracking, technical benchmarking) and be the most credible voice in the room on what the market actually believes — evidence, not anecdote
Feed that signal directly into product roadmap and pricing decisions
Build lightweight, repeatable, automatable processes to get customer voice and insight directly into product development and launches — this currently happens ad hoc and needs an owner
GTM orchestration
Own launch strategy and sequencing — what to launch, when, and how big a moment to make of it — partnering with Product on roadmap-to-revenue sequencing so GTM readiness isn't an afterthought
Define launch success metrics and report on them credibly to executive leadership
Champion and put structure around the shift toward faster product launches — building quickly and iterating based on real performance
Sales & CS enablement
Equip Sales to win deals with best-in-class sales collateral, tools, and enablement, and support strategic deals directly where
